objective: Test whether contrast-trained checkpoint 16 preserves the accepted attribution and narrative behavior before any fresh publisher-validation replication.

attribution.execution: Reuse the exact frozen-base artifacts from the routed benchmark; do not execute a memory model.

scene.execution: Reuse the signed 284-row open-fit progression result.

decoder.attribution: Exact frozen-base minimum-mean candidate continuation NLL; memory is never consulted.
decoder.narrative: Start from frozen-base labels and replace only base=narration with memory=scene_description for the same unit.
decoder.scene: Checkpoint-16 correct-state generation already measured by the signed open-fit progression.

execution.source_adapter: frozen V9 plus checkpoint-16 gate-only patch

progression.on_pass: Authorize writing a separate preregistered fresh publisher-validation replication contract; do not open validation under this protocol.
progression.on_failure: Archive the result and develop another TRAIN-derived intervention.

stopping_rule: Archive, commit, and push the complete preservation result whether pass or fail. Never inspect publisher validation predictions, publisher test, Hard32, or the unused 73-row strength holdout under this study.
